name: Blacks
overview: Scripture affirms the unity of all mankind created in God's image, as seen in Genesis 1:26, regardless of skin color or ethnicity. The Bible acknowledges the existence of different peoples, including those of African descent, such as the Ethiopian woman Moses married (Numbers 12:1) and the land of Ethiopia reaching out to God (Psalms 68:31). While physical differences like skin color are noted (Job 30:30), the focus remains on trusting the Lord and His design (Proverbs 3:5), with no biblical restriction against marriage between blacks and whites, as reflected in the subtopics concerning interracial marriage.
